description:
Delete the live-file gate registry reader and route its callers onto the captured image's declarations, so no command reads `gates.toml` outside an admitted capture.

## Background

- `load_gate_registry` (`crates/jit/src/storage/gate_store.rs`) probes `path.exists()` and reads the live `gates.toml` with `std::fs::read`, with no commit admission.
- Its non-test callers: `crates/jit/src/commands/gate.rs` (`self.exec.storage.load_gate_registry()` at ~812, ~966, ~987, ~1265) and `crates/jit/src/commands/gate_check.rs` (~1381, ~1426), reached through the `IssueStore` storage method of the same name.
- Story `d675102c` sol checkpoint review, finding 1. Invoker ruling: delete the reader, keep no second reader for tests (`@/charter/D-18`).
- Epic criteria: `b697a3f7` REQ-10 (read paths take declarations from a captured image) and REQ-12 (each evaluation resolves its registry once per captured image).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `load_gate_registry` and the storage method that exposes it no longer exist, and no code outside `crates/jit/src/storage/` reads `gates.toml` from the filesystem.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each former caller in `commands/gate.rs` and `commands/gate_check.rs` takes the gate registry from the declarations of the captured image its command already reads, or captures one, and a gate evaluation resolves its registry once per captured image.
- [hard] REQ-03: The registry's absent-file and duplicate-key behaviour each keep one owning test at the captured-declaration parse; tests that seeded or read the registry through the deleted reader use the captured path or are deleted as duplicates.
title: Gate registry reads come from the captured image; the live-file reader is gone
